question: How can I show different content in my documentation based on whether it's the development or production instance?
ground_truth: You can conditionally render content between instances by defining instances in your docs.yml file with different URLs and names, then using the <If instance={{["development"]}}> or <If instance={{["production"]}}> tags in your MDX files to wrap content that should only appear for specific instances.

metadata.cited_context:
Define instances in your `docs.yml` file:

```yaml docs.yml
instances:
  - url: fern-dev.docs.buildwithfern.com
    name: development
  - url: fern-prod.docs.buildwithfern.com
    name: production
```

```mdx conditional-rendering.mdx
<If instance={{["development"]}}>
  This is a beta feature. It should only be available when the docs have been generated with the `development` instance.
</If>

<If instance={{["production"]}}>
  This is a production feature. It should only be available when the docs have been generated with the `production` instance.
</If>
```
